capabilities: Track encounters and combat resources in a sidebar with HP, structure, stress, and heat controls
Roll inline dice via [Roll: XdY] syntax
Import NPC .lcp files and COMP/CON pilot .json exports into notes via user templates
Render interactive clocks, progress bars, and lancer-stats statblocks in Reading View
Show hover tooltips for Lancer status keywords in Reading View
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; requires Obsidian v1.4.0+.
problem: Running Lancer RPG combats and importing COMP/CON character data requires leaving Obsidian or building trackers by hand.

relations.evidence: Bridging the gap between COMP/CON and Obsidian with powerful data extractors.
designed to be used alongside the Lancer-OS Obsidian Theme

summary: Lancer RPG game-master suite that tracks combat encounters, rolls inline dice, imports NPC and pilot data, and renders clocks and statblocks.
